term: record arena with scenarios as worlds
definition: The #755 arena of an Exercise: worlds are scenarios, accessibility goes to allowed scenarios, and at the actual scenario the reasons of an effect are all members of its exercised admitted records. It differs from #752's recordArena, which has one world and contributors only.
note: Stipulative analyst notion for #745, reusing the #733 records. No source is claimed for it. See docs/notes/explanatory-closure-745.md. Calling a record member a reason is the analyst's reading; it does not show that the member explains the effect.
